Examples | Comparison

Setup

Load libraries:

Code 
library(tidyverse)
library(ggpubr)

Load in plots from example species case studies:

Code 
owl_plot <- readRDS("Outputs/Laughing Owl/summary_plot.rds")
courser_plot <- readRDS("Outputs/Jerdon's Courser/summary_plot.rds")
curlew_plot <- readRDS("Outputs/Slender-billed Curlew/summary_plot.rds")

Plot

Combine plots:

Code 
ggarrange(owl_plot, courser_plot, curlew_plot, ncol = 3)
